address: Unit PG-01, GF, Podium Block, Menara Keck Seng, 203 Jalan Bukit Bintang, Bukit Bintang, Kuala Lumpur, 55100, Malaysia
bio: Tucked away from the main street, Sushi Ori is famous locally for its sushi sets and omakase. The eponymous Japanese chef has lived in Malaysia for over 10 years and opened this traditional restaurant in 2019. Seasonal ingredients are delivered from Japan three times a week. The sushi rice comes from Akita and contains a secret mix of vinegar. With only limited seats at the counter, book well in advance for the personalised omakase experience. Private rooms are also available....
